204.description: The synonym entry was deleted. The response has no body.

401.description: The API key or access token is missing, malformed, or expired.

schema.description:
An error response in the Problem Details format defined by
[RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457). The API sends it with
the `application/problem+json` media type.

type.description:
Identifies the problem type. Compare this value to decide how to handle
the error. Each type has a fixed `title`.

title.description: A short summary of the problem type.

status.description: The HTTP status code of the response.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation of this occurrence of the problem.
examples: The synonyms field must contain at least one item.

instance.description: The path of the request that caused the problem.

errors.description: The fields that failed validation. Only validation problems include this field.

field.description: The name of the field that failed validation.

detail.description: The reason that the field failed validation.
examples: Must contain at least one item.

schema.title: ProblemDetails

403.description: The API key or access token is valid but doesn't have permission for the operation.
